messages:
mike: FYI sales queued another request: some EU tenants want an opt-in that only flips during a tenant-defined "peak window" (e.g., 17:00-20:00 CET) so they get cost savings without affecting daytime quality. They want deterministic rollback and audit logs.
zoe: Interesting. So per-tenant schedule + manual opt-in. We should make the schedule visible in Console and allow admins to preview expected traffic slices.
harry: From infra: implement as three layers: routing policy (time-window + tenant flag), A/B sampling probe for first N days, and a circuit-breaker hooked to pool utilization and regression signals.
nina: Quality gate proposal: run a 1:1 A/B sample on 2% of requests during the first 72h, compute semantic-similarity and hallucination rate on customer prompt set. If semantic-similarity drops by >1.2% OR hallucination rate increases by >0.7% -> immediate revert for that tenant.
sre-bot: canary-plan: scheduled job -> eu-peak-window-probe -> duration:72h -> initiator:harry.
mike: Audit & compliance: we need immutable logs of opt-in toggles (who enabled, what schedule, timestamps) and the ability to rollback to a specific commit/variant. CS asked for an email receipt when a toggle is changed.
zoe: Console UX: add a checkbox with the exact wording: "I understand my traffic may be served by a quantized variant during selected windows; I accept possible small quality variance." Also show a historical timeline of toggles and observed metrics.
harry: Routing details: warmup ramp per tenant: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 100% over configurable windows (default: 2h/6h/12h). Each step must pass gating signals: p95 latency change < +25% and error-rate delta < 0.3% and quality gate pass.
nina: Small tenants note: for tenants < 1TPS, extend observation to 7 days before full rollout since samples are sparse. Show an explicit "awaiting signal stability" state in Console.
mike: Rollback ladder: 1) flip tenant flag off, 2) set `force_pinned_variant=true` in feature flags, 3) if systemic issue -> route all EU opt-ins to premium pool and notify customers. Keep runbook steps with contact list.
sre-bot: alert-rule: gpu-pool-utilization > 82% for 3m -> trigger diversion to premium-pool for opt-in traffic.
harry: Also add soft-eviction: when a tenant is evicted we mark them as "auto-cooled" with a cooldown timer (default 24h) and store the reason in UI.
cs-bot: customer-notify: sending opt-in summary email to tenant admins upon enrollment.
zoe: Measurement: expose p95, p99, quality-delta, and opt-in % in Console. For privacy, paired outputs for A/B probes are stored encrypted and retained 30d.
nina: Owners: Zoe (Console + legal text), Harry (routing + circuit-breaker), Mike (runbook + CS comms), Nina (eval harness + gating).
mike: Action items: Harry to prod a staging router config + circuit-breaker hooks by Wed; Zoe to mock Console flow and copy by Tue; Nina to prepare per-tenant prompt templates and evaluation script by Thu; Mike to draft runbook and notification templates by Thu.
harry: Will also include a simulation job to estimate cost delta per tenant given their historical traffic - useful for sales to show expected savings.
zoe: UI should require tenant admin to provide an emergency contact and accept T&Cs before enabling.
mike: If no objections, start a staging probe tomorrow morning. We'll do a dry run with internal test tenants first.
zoe: No objections.
harry: thumbs up.
